response.courseDescription: 301 Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics Basic concepts in chemical engineering thermodynamics; First and Second Laws; property relationships; power, compression, and liquefaction.
response.coursePrerequisites: CHE 101, CHE 211, and CHEM 345 each with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; PHYSICS 202 and 212 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Chemical Engineering.
